modern: Reason and the art of reasoning, that is, philosophy, are powers which are sufficient for themselves and for their own works. They move, then, from a first principle which is their own, and they make their way to the end set before them; and this is why such acts are called Catorthoseis, or right acts, a word which signifies that they proceed by the right road.
original: Reason and the reasoning art [philosophy] are powers which are sufficient for themselves and for their own works. They move then from a first principle which is their own, and they make their way to the end which is proposed to them; and this is the reason why such acts are named Catorthoseis or right acts, which word signifies that they proceed by the right road.
